evidence: The agent loop answers a repeated call with a pointer to the earlier result (already_called, web/src/llm/agent.ts:422). The word-reading adapter reads that pointer as a result of its tool that holds nothing (web/src/llm/verdicts/recorded.ts:127, :139), and {{achieved}} reads each check's newest result (web/src/llm/verdicts/readers.ts:231, :267): a qmax_coverage "too far" followed by its repeat no longer needs attention, and a repeated ub_check, holding no angle, reads as a right UB (web/src/llm/verdicts/rules.ts:454).
proposed_fix: A repeated call's pointer holds no outcome of its own; both readers read the result it points to.
tests: web/src/llm/__tests__/answerChecks.test.ts (keeps {{achieved}} at not met after a pointer to a too far, and the answer checks send the claim back)
web/src/llm/__tests__/answerChecks.test.ts (reads a repeated ub_check as the UB it points to, not as a right one)
